rules: protect engine rendering/collision behavior rather than named content records
terrain behavior comes from the shared Terrain Library; no terrain ID is a privileged engine mechanic
mob behavior/rendering comes from ordinary shared Mob Type and Asset records; no built-in mob catalog
project content lives in content/shared and content/zones; config contains engine/global settings only
current schema is the only supported project/save format until a real compatibility requirement exists

camera.rule: POV changes modify CAMERA_ZOOM without replacing collision systems.

architecture_update: v74.4 keeps the completed art workflow and adds safer Builder UX: one-shot placement by default, explicit repeat placement, persistent tool state, section jumps, and per-tab scroll memory
balance_config: config/game-balance.js contains engine/global balance only; content-specific mobs/items/loot/NPCs/terrain live in project content.
github_actions: .github/workflows/static.yml is the canonical Pages workflow; Builder and local backups are excluded from production deployment.

content_model.terrain: ordinary Terrain Library records with properties such as walkable/healing/sanctuary/movement/decorations
content_model.mobs: ordinary Mob Type records linked to sprite Asset records; Mob Type displayHeight controls world size independently of source resolution
content_model.backward_compatibility: none; v74 schema-v8 is the clean current baseline

save_format.compatibility: none until a real released save requires it
